prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Desktop Pet Controls", "Try dragging your companion across your screen or using shortcut keys before finishing setup."]
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion Archetype", "Select between Playful Buddy, Calm Observer, or Productivity Partner"]
2: ["Upload & Validate Companion Photo", "Upload Front-Facing Photo", "Face Centered | Bright Lighting | High Resolution"]
3: ["Finalizing Desktop Companion Overlay..."]
4: ["Sign In & Protect Your Companion Data", "Existing Pets Auto-Synced & Safe"]
5: ["Companion Official Name", "Certified Desktop Pet Companion"]
6: ["Crafting Your Custom Desktop Companion", "Building 3D animations, desktop physics, and AI voice responses..."]
7: ["Stuck signing in? Click to send a 1-click passwordless magic link to your email."]
8: ["Unlock Your Exclusive Starter Desktop Accessories!", "Complete onboarding now to receive a free companion hat and desktop toy.", "Claim Rewards & Meet Pet"]
9: ["Meet Your AI Desktop Pet in 3 Easy Steps", "Choose an archetype, customize your pet, and place it on your desktop in under 3 minutes."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information by requiring a user face photo
Promises free gifts and extra items to incentivize completing onboarding
